scope: Eight different, UAE drives prospectively reserved for this revision and 27 real Microsoft Edge sessions per build. Every submitted photo was hashed in the browser against the original file. All five potential positives were chosen from photo pixels before either run: one marked whole-space reference with two accepted neighbouring bays and four unmarked off-lane point references. One independent AI judge; no passenger study, site visit or legal clearance.

builds.baseline: Canonical 8775 prior to the 20:49 UTC service restart; connected-pavement/observed-landmark policy v4.
builds.candidate: Canonical 8775 after /api/footage-catalog became available; parking-row and observed-landmark policy v5, with the four newly signed photo-level observations already installed.

measurement: Each natural request used a fresh normal typed browser session. Time runs from clicking Find my spot to a visible result, excluding loading and typing. The first-response deadline is 15 seconds with continued observation to 45; provider latency and reuse of already verified public model responses can differ between runs. An actionable waiting message, browser failure or provider timeout is not scored as an evidence-based withholding. A location can only be confirmed after a second user action.
findings: No natural positive produced a matching point, a choice or a whole outline with either build. One previously pending positive now received an evidence-based clarification. Both builds avoided an incorrect selectable destination on all three blocked requests. V5 resolved two of those three with evidence; the remaining occupied pair timed out.

An authenticated, pre-language source replay found exactly one eligible raw shape across the five positive images under both v4 and v5. It is a location and measured outline match to H01 bay A. The evidence bank supplies no geometry at all for H02 through H05 even before size/access filtering. Conversely H01 has a true underlying match that its low-divider description fails to select. Its generic gallery button produces just A. The shared divider represents two genuine alternatives but the app supplies one.

Passengers' travel-aisle taps were withheld on all eight images in both runs. H01's marked-space offer met the whole-bay coverage threshold; the other accepted interior points have no adjudicated complete footprint. On V5 the H03 server journal records a correct passenger-marked proposal while the real browser shows 'Failed to fetch' and stale marking controls. A fresh same-photograph retry displayed the correct point in 341 ms. The first-attempt visible score preserves the original transport/UI failure; server-side geometric success was four of five.
H08 supplied two raw shapes in both versions, both outside the connection to the ego road. No eligible shape survived and both ordinary requests correctly asked for a location on the near side.

supplemental_geometry.scope: Offline, original photograph and detector context bound to cryptographically verified segmentation/visual packets. Same original request and regions. V4 is replayed under its supported archive policy, while v5 uses its active policy. This source inspection is independent from the browser and does not add credit to any observed request.

source_and_evidence: Every original is linked from the plan. Grab and KartaView contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0. The local audit directory runs/passenger-placement-field-20261124 contains the original rendered PNG for each action plus the source-bound numerical grade. No authentication tokens or audio are included.

supplemental_browser_gallery.note: The official gallery sends 'Find the marked parking bays.'; the independent frozen generic probe uses 'Show me the marked parking bays.' and returned no results on either build. The separate, later-prespecified official gallery run produced the correct A outline on H01 in 586 ms on the old server and 664 ms on the new server. The old server restarted during the remainder, so only the complete candidate supplemental gallery is tabulated. The authenticated archive-policy replay supplies the other old-version geometry figures.

original_split_outcome.browser: Failed to fetch; still in mark mode with no proposed pin/save button after the 15 s HTTP wait.

historical_source_correction.summary: Every original in this cohort appeared in earlier project studies, sometimes with related landmarks or intents. The new exact wording, regions and version comparison were prospectively frozen. Photo-level novelty is not claimed.
